CC Series L: Cortech Kangaroo Cart Lid
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-cc200l-lid-for-kangaroo-cart
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/facilities-maintenance/kangaroo-cart/
Spec sheet: Kangaroo Cart and lid
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Kangaroo Cart Lid
Current H1: Cortech Kangaroo Cart Lid
Subtitle: Lid for the Cortech Kangaroo Cart in Flame Retardant, General Use, or Recycled Material
Current subtitle: Cortech USA Kangaroo Cart Lids CC200L, CC783L, CC680L, CC280L, CC720L, CC620L, CC2L, CC116L
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Kangaroo Cart Lid covers the Cortech Kangaroo All Purpose Delivery Cart (sold separately), for laundry, trash, and material handling in correctional, healthcare, and other high-abuse settings.
The lid is made in the same three materials and colors as the cart: flame retardant, general use, and 100% recycled. Choose the lid that matches your cart.
Fit: Made for the Cortech Kangaroo Cart
Material Options: Flame retardant, general use, or 100% recycled (Repro Black)
Colors: Blue Gray, Green, Blue, Gray, White, or Repro Black (custom colors available on request)
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
CC200L – Blue Gray: Flame retardant
CC783L – Green: Flame retardant
CC680L – Blue: Flame retardant
CC280L – Gray: General use
CC720L – Green: General use
CC620L – Blue: General use
CC2L – White: General use
CC116L – Repro Black: 100% recycled material
Installation and Options
No assembly is required.
[H2] Applications
The Kangaroo Cart lid suits facilities that want to cover laundry, trash, or supplies in a Kangaroo Cart.
Typical applications include:
Laundry collection and delivery in correctional facilities, hospitals, and behavioral healthcare facilities
Trash and recycling collection
Janitorial work and general material handling
Explore Anchortex's Prison Janitorial and Sanitation Supplies and Hospital Laundry Carts and Heavy Duty Basket Trucks collections for more carts and sanitation supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Facilities Maintenance
Cortech facilities maintenance products are molded to stand up to hard daily use in correctional facilities, behavioral healthcare facilities, and other high-abuse settings.
Cortech facilities maintenance includes:
Trash Receptacles: Cobra Cans in 20 to 55 gallon sizes, in flame retardant or food grade and general use material, and Cobra Mini Cans in 10 and 14 quart sizes
Can Dollies: Cobra Can dollies in two sizes
Carts: Kangaroo Carts and lids for laundry, trash, and material handling
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (57 characters): Cortech Kangaroo Cart Lid in Three Materials at Anchortex
Meta description (154 characters): Shop the Cortech Kangaroo Cart Lid. A lid for the Kangaroo All Purpose Delivery Cart in flame retardant, general use, or recycled material and six colors.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Facilities Maintenance" is a new section for the Cobra Can, Cobra Mini Can, can dolly, and Kangaroo Cart pages. It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: there are eight model numbers, so I left them out of the H1.
Tongue and groove seal: your current page says the lid has a "tongue and groove patent pending design" that seals "all individual compartments." The Kangaroo Cart has no compartments, and the Cortech spec sheet does not say this, so I left it out.
Variant names: your variants say "Food Grade Material" for CC2L, CC720L, CC280L, and CC620L. The Cortech spec sheet calls these "General Use." Would you like them renamed, for example "CC2L - White General Use Material"? Your current page also calls CC280L "Blue Gray"; the Cortech spec sheet says "Gray."
Weight and size: the Cortech spec sheet does not give a weight or size for the lid, so I left them out. Your variants are set to 20 lbs.
Warranty: the Cortech spec sheet gives a 10-year warranty for the cart but does not say whether it covers the lid, so I left the warranty out.
Collection links: the lid is in your Prison Janitorial and Sanitation Supplies and Hospital Laundry Carts collections, so I linked those two.
Product images: the page has one image. I did not find a photo of the lid on the Cortech website.
